knowledge:
- key_parameters: percent=Filtering threshold in selectGrps (e.g., 0.5 or 0.7) to retain phosphosites quantified in a minimum percentage of replicates ;; threshold=Predefined missingness threshold in scImpute to select sites for condition-specific imputation ;; percent1=Threshold in ptImpute for the condition with missing values ;; percent2=Threshold in ptImpute for the condition with quantified values ;; M=Design matrix in RUVphospho representing experimental conditions ;; k=Integer in RUVphospho denoting the expected number of experimental/treatment groups ;; ctl=Integer vector in RUVphospho indicating the row indices of stably phosphorylated sites (SPSs) used as negative controls ;; stat=Statistic used in phosCollapse (e.g., apply(abs(Tc), 1, max)) to summarize site-level data to gene-level ;; kRange=Range of cluster numbers to evaluate in runClue
- alternatives: ClueR (specifically runClue and clustOptimal) for time-course clustering ;; directPA (specifically directPA and perturbPlot2d) for 2D/3D directional pathway analysis ;; ruv (specifically RUV-III) which RUVphospho wraps for batch correction
- when_to_use: Use PhosR when analyzing mass-spectrometry-based phosphoproteomic datasets with biological replicates, missing values, potential batch effects, or when seeking to perform kinase-substrate relationship scoring and signalome network reconstruction.
- pitfalls: Missing values must be imputed before batch correction because RUV-III requires a complete data matrix ;; Failing to specify annotations (GeneSymbol, Site, Sequence, Residue) when creating the PhosphoExperiment object will trigger warnings and affect downstream steps ;; SPSs (stably phosphorylated sites) are species-specific; using mouse SPSs on other species without generating species-specific ones via getSPS can lead to poor normalization.

workflows.name: preprocessing_and_imputation
workflows.intent: Filter low-quality phosphosites, perform site/condition-specific and paired tail-based imputation, and scale the data.
input: quantification_matrix.csv (raw phosphoproteomic intensity or ratio matrix)
sample_groups.csv (experimental group/condition labels for each sample)
workflows.stages: 1. Create PhosphoExperiment object ;; 2. Filter phosphosites using selectGrps ;; 3. Impute missing values using scImpute and ptImpute ;; 4. Normalize using medianScaling ;; 5. Quality control visualization using plotQC
workflows.code:
ppe <- PhosphoExperiment(assays = list(Quantification = as.matrix(phospho.L6.ratio)), 
                  Site = as.numeric(gsub("[A-Z]","", sapply(strsplit(rownames(ppe), ";"), "[[", 3))),
                  GeneSymbol = sapply(strsplit(rownames(ppe), ";"), "[[", 2),
                  Residue = gsub("[0-9]","", sapply(strsplit(rownames(ppe), ";"), "[[", 3)),
                  Sequence = sapply(strsplit(rownames(ppe), ";"), "[[", 4))
ppe_filtered <- selectGrps(ppe, grps, 0.5, n=1) 
set.seed(123)
ppe_imputed_tmp <- scImpute(ppe_filtered, 0.5, grps)[,colnames(ppe_filtered)]
set.seed(123)
ppe_imputed <- ppe_imputed_tmp
ppe_imputed[,seq(6)] <- ptImpute(ppe_imputed[,seq(7,12)], 
                                 ppe_imputed[,seq(6)], 
                                 percent1 = 0.6, percent2 = 0, paired = FALSE)
ppe_imputed[,seq(13,18)] <- ptImpute(ppe_imputed[,seq(19,24)], 
                                     ppe_imputed[,seq(13,18)], 
                                     percent1 = 0.6, percent2 = 0, 
                                     paired = FALSE)
ppe_imputed_scaled <- medianScaling(ppe_imputed, scale = FALSE, assay = "imputed")
p1 = plotQC(SummarizedExperiment::assay(ppe_filtered,"Quantification"), 
    labels=colnames(ppe_filtered), 
    panel = "quantify", grps = grps)
p2 = plotQC(SummarizedExperiment::assay(ppe_imputed_scaled,"scaled"), 
    labels=colnames(ppe_imputed_scaled), panel = "quantify", grps = grps)

workflows.name: batch_correction
workflows.intent: Correct for batch effects across multiple runs or datasets using stably phosphorylated sites (SPSs) as negative controls.
input: imputed_quantification_matrix.csv (complete phosphoproteomic matrix without missing values)
sample_batches.csv (batch and treatment group labels for each sample)
workflows.stages: 1. Define design matrix ;; 2. Identify control (SPS) sites ;; 3. Run batch correction using RUVphospho ;; 4. Generate custom SPSs if needed using getSPS
workflows.code:
sites = paste(sapply(GeneSymbol(ppe), function(x)x),";",
                 sapply(Residue(ppe), function(x)x),
                 sapply(Site(ppe), function(x)x),
                 ";", sep = "")
design = model.matrix(~ grps - 1)
ctl = which(sites %in% SPSs)
ppe = RUVphospho(ppe, M = design, k = 3, ctl = ctl)
inhouse_SPSs <- getSPS(ppe.list, conds = cond.list)

workflows.name: pathway_and_kinase_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform 1D, 2D, and 3D pathway enrichment and kinase activity analysis.
workflows.stages: 1. Fit linear model using limma ;; 2. Summarize site-level data to gene-level using phosCollapse ;; 3. Perform 1D enrichment using pathwayOverrepresent and pathwayRankBasedEnrichment ;; 4. Perform 2D/3D kinase activity analysis using directPA and perturbPlot2d
workflows.code:
sites = paste(sapply(GeneSymbol(ppe), function(x)x),";",
                 sapply(Residue(ppe), function(x)x),
                 sapply(Site(ppe), function(x)x),
                 ";", sep = "")
f <- gsub("_exp\\d", "", colnames(ppe))
X <- model.matrix(~ f - 1)
fit <- lmFit(SummarizedExperiment::assay(ppe, "normalised"), X)
table.AICAR <- topTable(eBayes(fit), number=Inf, coef = 1)
table.Ins <- topTable(eBayes(fit), number=Inf, coef = 3)
table.AICARIns <- topTable(eBayes(fit), number=Inf, coef = 2)
contrast.matrix1 <- makeContrasts(fAICARIns-fIns, levels=X)
contrast.matrix2 <- makeContrasts(fAICARIns-fAICAR, levels=X)
fit1 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast.matrix1)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast.matrix2)
table.AICARInsVSIns <- topTable(eBayes(fit1), number=Inf)
table.AICARInsVSAICAR <- topTable(eBayes(fit2), number=Inf)
o <- rownames(table.AICARInsVSIns)
Tc <- cbind(table.Ins[o,"logFC"], table.AICAR[o,"logFC"], table.AICARIns[o,"logFC"])
rownames(Tc) <- sites[match(o, rownames(ppe))]
rownames(Tc) <- gsub("(.*)(;[A-Z])([0-9]+)(;)", "\\1;\\3;", rownames(Tc))
colnames(Tc) <- c("Ins", "AICAR", "AICAR+Ins")
Tc.gene <- phosCollapse(Tc, id=gsub(";.+", "", rownames(Tc)), 
                        stat=apply(abs(Tc), 1, max), by = "max")
geneSet <- names(sort(Tc.gene[,1], 
                        decreasing = TRUE))[seq(round(nrow(Tc.gene) * 0.1))]
path1 <- pathwayOverrepresent(geneSet, annotation=pathways, 
                                universe = rownames(Tc.gene), alter = "greater")
path2 <- pathwayRankBasedEnrichment(Tc.gene[,1], 
                                    annotation=pathways, 
                                    alter = "greater")
dpa1 <- directPA(Tc[,c(1,3)], direction=0, 
                 annotation=lapply(PhosphoSite.rat, function(x){gsub(";[STY]", ";", x)}), 
                 main="Direction pathway analysis")
z1 <- perturbPlot2d(Tc=Tc[,c(1,2)], 
                    annotation=lapply(PhosphoSite.rat, function(x){gsub(";[STY]", ";", x)}),
                    cex=1, xlim=c(-2, 4), ylim=c(-2, 4), 
                    main="Kinase perturbation analysis")

workflows.name: time_course_clustering
workflows.intent: Cluster time-course phosphoproteomic data to identify temporal profiles and enriched kinases/pathways.
input: time_course_quantification.csv (phosphoproteomic matrix across multiple time points)
workflows.stages: 1. Filter and average replicates using matANOVA and meanAbundance ;; 2. Collapse to gene level (optional) using phosCollapse ;; 3. Run clustering evaluation using runClue ;; 4. Identify optimal clusters and find enriched pathways/kinases using clustOptimal
workflows.code:
grps <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(ppe), "_"), 
            function(x)x[3])
sites.p <- matANOVA(SummarizedExperiment::assay(ppe, "Quantification"), 
                    grps)
ppm <- meanAbundance(SummarizedExperiment::assay(ppe, "Quantification"), grps)
sel <- which((sites.p < 0.05) & (rowSums(abs(ppm) > 1) != 0))
ppm_filtered <- ppm[sel,]
ppm_gene <- phosCollapse(ppm_filtered, 
            gsub(";.+", "", rownames(ppm_filtered)), 
                stat = apply(abs(ppm_filtered), 1, max), by = "max")
RNGkind("L'Ecuyer-CMRG")
set.seed(123)
c1 <- runClue(ppm_gene, annotation=pathways, 
            kRange = seq(2,10), rep = 5, effectiveSize = c(5, 100), 
            pvalueCutoff = 0.05, alpha = 0.5)
best <- clustOptimal(c1, rep=5, mfrow=c(2, 3), visualize = TRUE)

workflows.name: signalome_construction
workflows.intent: Construct and visualize kinase-substrate networks (signalomes) from dynamic phosphoproteomic data.
input: flanking_sequences.csv (flanking amino acid sequences for each phosphosite)
workflows.stages: 1. Filter for dynamic sites and standardise using standardise ;; 2. Score kinase-substrate relationships using kinaseSubstrateScore ;; 3. Predict kinase-substrate links using kinaseSubstratePred ;; 4. Construct signalomes using Signalomes ;; 5. Visualize using plotSignalomeMap and plotKinaseNetwork
workflows.code:
phosphoL6.mean <- meanAbundance(phosphoL6, grps = gsub("_.+", "", colnames(phosphoL6)))
aov <- matANOVA(mat=phosphoL6, grps=gsub("_.+", "", colnames(phosphoL6)))
idx <- (aov < 0.05) & (rowSums(phosphoL6.mean > 0.5) > 0)
phosphoL6.reg <- phosphoL6[idx, ,drop = FALSE]
L6.phos.std <- standardise(phosphoL6.reg)
rownames(L6.phos.std) <- paste0(GeneSymbol(ppe), ";", Residue(ppe), Site(ppe), ";")[idx]
L6.phos.seq <- Sequence(ppe)[idx]
L6.matrices <- kinaseSubstrateScore(substrate.list = PhosphoSite.mouse, 
                                    mat = L6.phos.std, seqs = L6.phos.seq, 
                                    numMotif = 5, numSub = 1, verbose = FALSE)
set.seed(1)
L6.predMat <- kinaseSubstratePred(L6.matrices, top=30, verbose = FALSE) 
kinaseOI = c("PRKAA1", "AKT1")
Signalomes_results <- Signalomes(KSR=L6.matrices, 
                                predMatrix=L6.predMat, 
                                exprsMat=L6.phos.std, 
                                KOI=kinaseOI)
plotSignalomeMap(signalomes = Signalomes_results, color = kinase_signalome_color)
plotKinaseNetwork(KSR = L6.matrices, predMatrix = L6.predMat, threshold = 0.9, color = kinase_all_color)
